decisions.what: Routed phase 1 as low complexity (single file, single exported function, no new dependency).
decisions.why: Blast radius is one module; the only caller is http.ts:dispatchAuthedRequest and its signature is unchanged.

decisions.what: Auto-approved the plan (4 tasks, 1 checkpoint, no concerns).
decisions.why: No approval signal fired: task count 4 (<15), complexity low, no complexity override, handoff concerns empty.

decisions.what: Landed the failing HTTP-boundary test before touching scopes.ts.
decisions.why: Checkpoint in Task 1 required observing the before-state (201 / 200 / 200) so the fix is proven, not assumed.

decisions.what: Reused the existing trigger-job scope for the mutating entries instead of adding a scope.
decisions.why: SCOPE_VOCABULARY is pinned; a new scope needs an ADR plus a TokenScopeSchema change. v1-bridge-routes.ts sets the precedent for reuse.

decisions.what: Gave GET-only prefixes write: null (default-deny) rather than a synthesized write scope.
decisions.why: Fails in the safe direction: a future mutating handler on those prefixes stays denied until its entry is updated deliberately.

decisions.what: Kept every layer upstream of the scope check, and every route handler, untouched.
decisions.why: Out of scope per the spec's problem boundary; the fix did not require them. requiredScopeForRoute keeps its exported signature and has one production call site.

decisions.what: Inverted the method classifier from a four-verb mutating deny-list to a SAFE_METHODS allow-list (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS).
decisions.why: Security review found the write:null guarantee was enforced against only four verbs; Node's parser accepts and dispatches MOVE/PROPPATCH/QUERY and others, which would have inherited the read scope. Latent, not live — no handler serves those verbs — but the guarantee is the point of the null.

decisions.what: Reordered /api/local-models ahead of /api/local-model and pinned a no-shadowing invariant test.
decisions.why: Security review found the singular prefix shadowed the plural one under first-match-wins, making the plural entry dead code and the unit case that named it vacuous. Behavior-neutral today; a fail-open the moment either entry is given a different scope.

decisions.what: Corrected the changeset's 'admin tokens unaffected' claim and documented the trigger-job lateral move.
decisions.why: Security review verified write:null short-circuits ahead of the admin superset check, so admin now gets 403 (was 404) on those routes — an admin-visible change the changeset had denied.

decisions.what: Parked the cross-layer method-case normalization suggestion.
decisions.why: Would require editing the enforcement call site in http.ts, which is outside this change's boundary. Review confirmed all three resolution layers fail closed on a case mismatch, so there is no bypass — recorded for a follow-up.

gates.beforeFix: 5 failed / 1 passed — POST /api/plans returned 201 and DELETE /api/sessions/<id> returned 200 with a read-status-only bearer
gates.securityReview: PASS — 1 MEDIUM + 3 LOW addressed in-branch; 1 LOW parked as out-of-boundary; no exploitable bypass found across method case, verb substitution, override headers, path normalization, prefix shadowing, or the v1 rewrite
